fullDescription:
MEROVEL is a sophisticated retro display serif font inspired by vintage fashion editorials, timeless glamour, and feminine luxury. Designed with high-contrast strokes, delicate hairlines, and graceful proportions, MEROVEL brings an elegant and distinctive character to every design.

With its refined serif details and dramatic display presence, MEROVEL is perfect for creating luxury branding, fashion logos, beauty packaging, editorial designs, wedding stationery, invitations, magazine covers, and elegant social media graphics.

MEROVEL combines the charm of vintage typography with a polished contemporary aesthetic, making it versatile for both nostalgic and modern luxury projects. Its elegant letterforms are especially striking when used in large headlines, logos, titles, monograms, and sophisticated display compositions.

Whether you’re designing a fashion brand, boutique identity, beauty label, wedding invitation, magazine, product packaging, or luxury campaign, MEROVEL adds an effortlessly glamorous and feminine touch.
